t: Use cases: shared inboxes that copy themselves
d: Fifty real team setups with one inbox fanned out to the whole team.

t: Customer support: every agent gets every ticket
d: Give every support agent their own copy of each ticket email. Sinka fans one support inbox out to the whole team — no forwarding rules, no shared login.

t: IT helpdesk: one inbox, every technician covered
d: One help@ inbox fanned out to every IT technician's own inbox. No shared password, no ticket system to learn — just email that arrives everywhere it should.

t: Sales: every rep sees every lead
d: Stop losing leads to a shared sales@ login. Sinka copies every enquiry into each salesperson's own inbox within minutes — first responder wins, nothing slips.

t: Real estate: no enquiry waits for one agent
d: Portal enquiries (Zillow, Realtor, Rightmove) land in one inbox and reach every agent. Sinka copies each enquiry to the whole team — no forwarding, no missed viewings.

t: Property management: the crew sees the leak first
d: Tenant maintenance mail copied to managers, technicians and the office at once. Sinka fans one rentals inbox out to the crew — urgent leaks don't wait on one login.

t: School office: every teacher hears it once
d: A school office inbox fanned out to teachers and staff. Parent emails and admin notices land in each teacher's own inbox.

t: Admissions: every counsellor sees every applicant
d: Admissions enquiries copied to every counsellor's own inbox. One admissions address fanned out to the team all application season.

t: Tutoring center: no parent waits on one phone
d: Parent emails and schedule changes copied to every tutor's inbox. Sinka gives a tutoring center one parent-facing address with whole-team coverage.

t: Dental clinic: emergencies reach a dentist, not a queue
d: Appointment and emergency emails copied to reception and dentists at once. Sinka fans one clinic inbox out to the team — toothaches don't wait on one login.

t: Vet clinic: the whole team sees the sick Labrador
d: Appointment requests, lab results and worried owners, copied to the whole vet team. Sinka fans one clinic inbox out to vets, nurses and reception alike.

t: Plumbing: the job reaches the nearest van
d: Emergency call-outs and quote requests copied to the office and every plumber. Sinka fans one bookings inbox out to the vans — burst pipes don't wait.

t: Electrical: estimates and call-outs to the right hands
d: Call-outs and certificate requests copied to estimators and electricians. Sinka gives an electrical contractor whole-team coverage from one address.

t: Cleaning: quotes answered before the prospect asks twice
d: Quote requests and rota changes copied to the office and every team lead. Sinka fans one bookings inbox out to a cleaning company that never sits still.

t: Landscaping: quote it from the mower
d: Garden estimates and seasonal clean-up requests copied to the office and crew chiefs. Sinka keeps a landscaping crew quoting while they mow.

t: Restaurants: every manager sees the delivery change
d: Supplier invoices, delivery changes and health-inspector mail copied to every location manager. Sinka fans one operations inbox out across the group.

t: Catering: the driver and the kitchen read the same order
d: Event orders and last-minute changes copied to kitchen, drivers and the planner. Sinka keeps a catering business in sync from one inbox.

t: Boutique hotel: the request beats the guest upstairs
d: Guest requests copied to reception, housekeeping and the manager at once. Sinka fans one stay@ inbox out across a boutique hotel.

t: Travel agency: schedule changes reach an agent, not a queue
d: Booking confirmations, schedule changes and visa queries copied to every agent. Sinka fans one bookings inbox out across a travel agency.

t: Event planning: every vendor thread, visible to the team
d: Florist quotes, venue contracts and photographer timelines copied to planners and assistants. Sinka keeps an event team on the same page from one inbox.

t: Photography studio: the date gets claimed, not queued
d: Shoot enquiries copied to every photographer's own inbox. Sinka lets a studio answer fast without sharing a login — first available shooter wins the date.

t: Law firm intake: every potential client gets an answer
d: Potential-client mail copied to intake staff and attorneys. Sinka gives a law firm whole-team intake coverage with no shared password and a clean record.

t: Accounting firm: deadline mail reaches an accountant
d: Tax documents and deadline queries copied to every accountant's inbox. Sinka fans one clients inbox out across an accounting firm through tax season.

t: Insurance: the claim reaches a broker, not a queue
d: Claims and renewal queries copied to every broker's inbox. Sinka gives an insurance agency shared awareness without a shared login.

t: Mortgage broker: broker and processor read the same file
d: Bank statements and solicitor queries copied to broker and processor at once. Sinka keeps a two-person mortgage operation in lockstep from one inbox.

t: Dealership: the lead reaches a salesperson in minutes
d: Portal and website leads copied to every salesperson's inbox. Sinka gives a dealership speed-to-lead without a CRM tax on every desk.

t: Auto repair: the booking reaches the advisor, not the pile
d: Booking requests and parts queries copied to service advisors and the workshop. Sinka fans one bookings inbox out across an auto repair shop.

t: Dispatch: the load offer reaches a dispatcher awake
d: Load offers and POD queries copied to every dispatcher's inbox. Sinka keeps a dispatch desk covering freight around the clock from one address.

t: Moving company: the crew chief sees the date change
d: Move quotes and date changes copied to the office and crew chiefs. Sinka keeps a moving company quoting while the trucks roll.

t: Warehouse: the floor sees the delivery change
d: ASN notices, shortage claims and delivery slots copied to office and floor. Sinka fans one warehouse inbox out to desks and forklifts alike.

t: E-commerce: support and warehouse read the same order
d: Order queries, returns and address changes copied to support and warehouse. Sinka stops the 'support said yes, warehouse never heard' gap.

t: Marketing pod: the feedback reaches the designer, not the account manager's inbox
d: Client feedback and approvals copied to strategists, creatives and media. Sinka gives a marketing pod shared client awareness from one address.

t: Design studio: the brief reaches the designer doing the work
d: Briefs and revision notes copied to every designer's own inbox. Sinka lets a design studio brief once and reach the whole team.

t: Software agency: the bug report reaches the developer, not the PM's inbox
d: Bug reports and spec changes copied to developers' own inboxes. Sinka keeps a dev team aligned from one client-facing address.

t: Church office: the rota change reaches the volunteer
d: Prayer requests, rotas and hall-booking mail copied to staff and volunteers. Sinka fans one church office inbox out to the people who serve.

t: Nonprofit: fundraising and finance read the same donor
d: Donation queries and gift-aid forms copied to fundraising and finance. Sinka keeps a nonprofit's donor mail visible to both teams from one address.

t: Sports club: the fixture change reaches the coach
d: Trial requests and fixture changes copied to coaches and admin. Sinka fans one club inbox out to everyone who runs the weekend.

t: Fitness studio: the 6am cancellation reaches the coach
d: Trial bookings and cancellation mail copied to every coach's inbox. Sinka lets a fitness studio cover classes without a shared login.

t: Salon: the stylist sees the booking, not just reception
d: Booking requests and schedule swaps copied to stylists and reception. Sinka fans one bookings inbox out across a salon and spa.

t: Physio clinic: the referral reaches the therapist
d: GP referrals and booking changes copied to therapists and reception. Sinka fans one clinic inbox out to the people who treat.

t: Recruitment: the CV reaches a consultant in minutes
d: Candidate CVs and client briefs copied to every consultant's inbox. Sinka lets a recruitment agency work a role without sharing a login.

t: HR: every recruiter sees every application
d: Job applications copied to every recruiter's own inbox. Sinka fans one careers address out across HR — no shared login, no lost candidates.

t: Construction: the foreman reads the revision, not just the office
d: Drawing revisions and delivery notices copied to office and foremen. Sinka fans one site inbox out to cabins and desks alike.

t: Architecture studio: the markup reaches the architect drawing it
d: Client markups and planning conditions copied to every architect's inbox. Sinka lets a studio respond as one from a single address.

t: Farm co-op: every member sees the buyer's order
d: Buyer orders and collection slots copied to every member farm. Sinka fans one orders inbox out across a co-operative.

t: Bakery chain: the wholesale order reaches the ovens
d: Wholesale and catering orders copied to every branch bakery. Sinka fans one orders inbox out across a bakery chain.

t: Coffee roaster: the café order reaches the roast
d: Café bean orders and machine-service calls copied to roastery and drivers. Sinka keeps a roaster's cafés supplied from one inbox.

t: Florist: the designer and the driver read the same brief
d: Wedding briefs and date changes copied to designers and the delivery driver. Sinka keeps a florist shop blooming from one inbox.

t: Pet grooming: the groomer reads the temperament note
d: Booking requests and temperament notes copied to groomers and reception. Sinka fans one bookings inbox out across a grooming salon.

t: Music school: the enquiry reaches the teacher
d: Trial-lesson enquiries copied to teachers and admin. Sinka fans one admissions inbox out across a music school.

t: Coworking: the tour booking reaches community, not a queue
d: Member requests, tour bookings and parcel notices copied to community and ops teams. Sinka fans one hello inbox out across a coworking space.
